S1.why: Bare label in the shape a bracket wants; 'zdarma' becomes the short name for the free slots, reused in S29 and K1.

S2.why: An invitation in the formal imperative the vocab uses (Zapněte); says carry on, never mentions a limit.

S3.s: Využili jste všech %lld cutlingů zdarma. Zůstanou vám zdarma a budou fungovat dál.
S3.back: Used-up you-have all 5 cutlings free. Will-remain to-you free and will work on.
S3.why: Genitive plural cutlingů after 5 (vocab: Cutlingů); lowercase item noun mid-sentence as in the vocab sentence; the second sentence says nothing is taken away.

S4.why: Perfective future reads as what the person gets, not as a rule; 'zdarma' fronted for weight.

S5.why: 'z 5 cutlingů' governs the noun, so any used count (1, 2, 3, 4) reads right; numbers keep English order, so no positional forms are needed.

S6.why: Noun phrase for a bold row line; 24 characters with '5 000', exactly the budget.

S7.why: Uses the vocab's two kinds (Textový Cutling, Obrázkový Cutling) as adjectives sharing one noun, so no new word for text or image items.

S8.why: Czech lists with 'a' and no comma before it.

S9.s: Jeden nákup platí na všech zařízeních s vaším účtem Apple.
S9.back: One purchase is-valid on all devices with your account Apple.
S9.why: 'účet Apple' and 'zařízení' as in the vocab's iCloud sentence; lowercase 'vaším' as Apple's Czech writes it.

S10.why: Plain present tense, warmer than the noun 'Jednorázová platba'.

S11.why: Natural Czech negative list with 'ani'; 'registrace' is the everyday word for signing up.

S12.why: The wording Czech iOS apps use for the App Store restore action.

S13.why: Verbal noun plus ellipsis character, the way Czech iOS writes progress (Načítání…, Stahování…).

S14.why: Infinitive is the Czech button form; 'jednorázově' carries pay-once in 25 characters plus the price.

S15.why: The same action without the price; infinitive button form.

S16.why: Apple's Czech 'Not Now': putting it off, not refusing.

S17.why: The plain verb iOS uses on Czech close buttons.

S18.why: 'celý' says all of it, room included; lowercase 'váš' as in the vocab; 19 characters.

S19.s: Díky za nákup. Podpořili jste Cutling i člověka, který ho sám vyvíjí.
S19.back: Thanks for purchase. Supported you-have Cutling and-also the-person who it alone develops.
S19.why: 'Díky' rather than 'Děkujeme', since no team speaks; 'sám vyvíjí' names the one maker without sounding like a plea.

S20.s: Vítejte zpět. Váš předchozí nákup je obnoven.
S20.back: Welcome back. Your previous purchase is restored.
S20.why: Standard Czech greeting for a returning person; short passive 'je obnoven' as Czech UI writes completed states.

S21.why: Impersonal participle reads cleanly aloud as a VoiceOver value; 'z 5 cutlingů' fixes the case for any used count.

S22.s: Cutlingů: %lld. Teď se jich vejde až %@.
S22.back: Of-cutlings: 5. Now themselves of-them fits up-to 5 000.
S22.why: Reuses the vocab's count form 'Cutlingů: %lld', which reads right for 1, 2, 5 and 21 with no plural rules; 'vejde se jich' is how a speaker says how many fit.

S23.s: Cutling je odemčený. Vejde se do něj %@ cutlingů.
S23.back: Cutling is unlocked. Fits itself into it 5 000 cutlings.
S23.why: Capital C for the app, lowercase for the items, as in the vocab; singular verb is correct after 5 000.

S24.why: Impersonal 'nepodařilo se' names no one at fault; 28 characters.

S25.s: App Store teď není dostupný. Zkuste to prosím za chvíli znovu.
S25.back: App Store now is-not available. Try it please in a-while again.
S25.why: App Store takes masculine agreement in Czech; 'za chvíli' is the natural 'shortly'.

S26.why: States what happened and who did it, with no blame on the person.

S27.s: Na účtu Apple přihlášeném v tomto zařízení není žádný nákup Cutlingu.
S27.back: On account Apple signed-in in this device is-not any purchase of-Cutling.
S27.why: 'účet Apple' from the vocab; genitive 'Cutlingu' for the app (hard masculine inanimate); 69 characters.

S28.s: Verze zdarma pojme %lld cutlingů. Stačí Cutling jednou odemknout a uložíte si jich, kolik chcete.
S28.back: Version free holds 5 cutlings. Suffices Cutling once to-unlock and you-will-save yourself of-them as-many-as you-want.
S28.why: 'Stačí … jednou odemknout' makes 'jednou' read as once, not some day; 97 characters.

S29.why: Compact pair under the list title, echoing S1; 12 characters.

K1.why: Fits 34 of 38 characters; 'zdarma' as the free slots echoes S1, and the action word after the dot tells the person what a tap does.

M1.why: Verb-led infinitive, as Czech macOS names command windows.

M2.why: Same command as M1 with the ellipsis character because it opens a window.

M3.why: Row label uses the vocab's list word 'Cutlingy', capitalised as a label.

M4.why: Czech writes a used-of-total pair with 'z'.

M5.why: Full status line, 19 characters, since the row loses its M3 label once bought.

M6.s: Jedním nákupem odemknete Cutling na iPhonu, iPadu a Macu.
M6.back: With-one purchase you-unlock Cutling on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
M6.why: Locative forms iPhonu, iPadu, Macu as Czech speakers decline them; 'a' as the list conjunction, as in S8.

M7.s: Odemčeno na iPhonu, iPadu a Macu s tímto účtem Apple.
M7.back: Unlocked on iPhone, iPad and Mac with this account Apple.
M7.why: Impersonal 'Odemčeno' for a status line; 'účet Apple' from the vocab.

M8.s: Cutling jste si koupili ještě předtím, než byl zdarma, takže vám zůstává odemčený. Díky.
M8.back: Cutling you-have yourself bought still before, than it-was free, so to-you remains unlocked. Thanks.
M8.why: Says the cause with 'takže' and ends on the same 'Díky' as S19; 89 characters.
